scope: Original Forward+ full framebuffers. Fixed30Hz capture is simulation sampling, not hardware FPS. Static context and 1.2s diagnostic clip do not certify full gameplay or commercial graphics parity.

sequence_controls.scope: Unchanged groom station/pose/light controls on diagnostic environment; component comparison only.

bounds.scope: Actual imported visible mesh vertices, final modifier pose snapshot, inverse binds, live morphs and actual alpha-squared shader offsets. Projection does not prove visibility or collision clearance.

face.scope: Authored eyelid morph performance only, optional authored half-blink arc correctives. No eye scaling, facial shader warp, skeleton modification, gaze or jaw expression.

ground_contact.scope: Actual collision-world downward ray at staged actor origin; does not certify cloth or hair collision.

lod.scope: One existing rig; body/bow visibility only; source face/morph writer remains unique; actual posed LOD acceptance and GPU profiling are separate.

motion.scope: Original full-body clips with layered authority-driven actions and support-foot IK; continuous rendered review remains separate.

shots.scope: S1 gold component pair; actual imported materials, source-pinned staged camera/light/pose, diagnostic environment. Not production environment or title-interface acceptance.

secondary.scope: Bounded analytic spring response through authored rest-space masks. No cloth collision, strands, gameplay or skeleton writes.
